newsitem.title: DENMARK: BG Bank sees 1997 core earnings higher.
newsitem.headline: BG Bank sees 1997 core earnings higher.

text.p: Denmark's third-biggest bank, BG Bank, said on Tuesday that it expected 1997 full-year core earnings to be higher than those in 1996.

It had previously predicted 1997 earnings slightly lower than the previous year's record 1.665 billion crowns but upgraded its forecast on publication of its 1997 first half figures, which showed core earnings of 968 million crowns.
It logged pre-tax profits of 1.063 billion crowns for the first six months of 1997, compared with 821 million for the same period the year before.
A statement accompanying the results said that the bank expected continued growth in deposits and borrowing but that narrowing spreads meant that net interest earnings would not grow.
